Method of Attack: Encrypting files and appending specific extensions (.agho for STOP, .DUSK for Dusk 2, .howareyou for HowAreYou, .kmd for AgeLocker, .devos for Devos)
Dropping ransom notes (e.g., README.txt for Dusk 2 variant)
Using ransomware to encrypt victim files and demand ransom
Impacted Systems: General computer systems (STOP, Dusk 2, HowAreYou, Devos)
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection leading to file encryption
Indicators of Compromise: File extensions appended to encrypted files: .agho, .DUSK, .howareyou, .kmd, .devos, .vvoa
Ransom note files such as README.txt
